resources.string: Sync subtitles to audio
Aligns subtitles with the dialogue when Auto Sync can't find a reliable match.
English speech model (%1$d MB)
Optional. Recognizes English speech and matches it with external English subtitles, for faster and more accurate sync. Uses more CPU and memory.
Downloading… %1$d%%
Downloaded. If playback struggles, delete it to sync with speech detection only.
Download failed. Select to retry. Speech detection still works.
Download
Delete
Audio sampling
Listens to dialogue ahead of playback, so the sync is found sooner.
Off
Low
High
Listens only to what is playing, so syncing takes longer. Doesn't work with the mpv player.
Listens ahead to a few dialogue scenes over one extra connection, up to 75 MB per title. Also used instead of High on metered networks.
Fastest sync. Listens ahead to more scenes over several connections, usually up to 150 MB per title, and uses more CPU. Some servers limit how many connections they allow.
Audio subtitle sync
Speech detection uses Silero VAD v5 weights (MIT, Silero Team). Optional speech recognition uses sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0, k2-fsa) and its Zipformer GigaSpeech English model (Apache-2.0).
Full notices ship with the app in licenses/audio_sync_NOTICE.md.
